Verified and closing **NAV-015** after all four original acceptance criteria, source and actual results were reviewed:

- **C1:** accepted debug/release merged-manifest maps cover all 24 menu rows; their applicable source bytes remain unchanged.
- **C2:** approved fresh-install Call request/grant accepted.
- **C3:** real document/photo picker operation accepted without all-files or unrelated SMS permissions.
- **C4:** actual denial/permanent-denial and API33 media results reused; the remaining **API34 media method now passes 1/1** in [run41297305980](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/41297305980), attempt1 at `ff4f60dcc14f8e6a08237bbc678634da5f3d8a58`. One original XML, Gradle exit0/39.01s; real OS selected-photo choice, native selected/full-grant distinctions, public Limited/Available state and owned cleanup were checked.

The 34 passive original-review checks are not 34 tests. Five cumulative accepted native executions are not a new5/5 workflow. Accepted Call/picker/denial/API33 were **not replayed**; the earlier serial media workflow remains failed at its unexecuted API34 KVM admission. API34 selection is platform-issued, not a library-selected request result or file-read proof. #118 storage and physical/packaged/API-ABI/security/release gates remain separate. Public APIs, original issue text/labels and all failed history are preserved.
